assets.description: Steep A-frame timber cabin: glazed front gable with door, living + kitchenette below, sleeping loft reached by a centre stair, deck.
Single-storey steel diner: counter with stools, booth tables, kitchen, striped awning, big neon roof sign.

6-storey mosaic-tile walk-up: arcade with convenience store + breakfast shop, 10 one-bedroom flats (2 per floor), central U-stair, grilled windows, balconies with laundry, rooftop iron-sheet addition with water tanks.
5F walk-up: G/F ramen shop with counter seating, 2F-4F one-bedroom flats with balcony, 5F loft studio, roof terrace with water tank. Shared U-stair core.
Cream-brick 2-storey bakery: bread display, oven, café table, striped awning; baker's flat upstairs.
Granite neoclassical bank on a podium: columned portico with pediment, banking hall with teller counter, vault/server room, offices upstairs.
Crisp white cubic 2-storey house: ribbon windows, flat roof terrace, cantilever entrance canopy, red accent panel.
3-storey brick bookshop: G/F bookstacks, 2F café with counter and tables, 3F reading loft flat, green awning.

Raised concrete podium, timber post-and-beam café with full glazing, 20ft black container kitchen, outdoor stair to a planted terrace, 40ft yellow container lounge with sliding glass wall, timber canopy roof.

Stone quay platform in the water with a teal 5-storey and an ochre 6-storey tower sharing one U-stair; G/F grocery + noodle bar, flats above, roof terrace, lanterns, jetty with two rowing boats, boardwalk to shore.
7-storey slim capsule hotel: lobby, floors of stacked bunk capsules + lounges, roof terrace, neon blade sign.
4-storey square stone keep with corner turrets: great hall, armoury/storage, lord's chamber + library, crenellated roof walk with banners.
Introverted fair-faced concrete 2-storey house: few deep windows, minimal interior, flat roof, single maple tree.
Windowless steel data hall: server rooms with rack rows and consoles, NOC office, roof chillers, backup generators.
5-storey timber-clad eco block: every flat has a planted balcony with trailing greenery, roof garden with trees and solar.
Brick 2-storey station: double apparatus bay with two ladder trucks behind roller doors, hose tower, upstairs dorm + lounge.
White clapboard 2-storey flower shop: plant-filled shop floor, flower stands on the pavement, green awning, flat above with flower boxes.
2-storey black game centre: rows of arcade cabinets, claw machines, upstairs arcade + bar, neon signage.
Convenience kiosk with shelves and counter, big illuminated canopy over four pumps, price pylon.
4-storey dark glass cube: lobby + café, open-plan offices and meeting rooms, roof terrace with solar canopy.
Single-storey white-framed glasshouse with a glass gable roof: café counter, tables among potted palms and ferns.
6-storey mosaic tenement: cha chaan teng diner, caged balconies, AC units, neon blade sign, laundry, rooftop.
3-storey tiled hospital: lobby + triage clinics, wards with beds, exam rooms, roof terrace, drop-off canopy, ambulance, red cross.
6-storey Art Deco hotel: black-marble lobby with reception + bar, restaurant, 24 guest rooms, brass-trimmed stepped crown, vertical fins.

Stone plinth, dark timber G/F with living/kitchen/bath, half-timbered plaster upper floor with tatami room and bedroom, blue slate hip roofs with upturned corners, covered balcony + outside stair, garden with lantern.
Teal clapboard 2-storey teahouse on a raised timber deck around an old tree trunk; red-framed bay windows, paper lanterns, roof terrace with antennas.
Timber-fronted izakaya: counter bar with stools, tables, kitchen, red lanterns and noren; small flat above; slate gable.
4-storey black KTV: G/F bar, private karaoke lounges on upper floors (sofa + TV), neon floor bands, vertical blade sign.
Single-storey cheerful kindergarten: classroom + play lounge, red tile gable, playground with slide, swings and sandbox.
Single-storey hanok on a stone plinth: timber posts, raised wooden maru veranda, paper sliding doors, curved tiled hip roof.
Narrow timber townhouse: G/F sweets shop with noren curtain and lanterns, tatami living above, sliding lattice windows, slate gable.
Narrow 3-storey mosaic block: G/F coin laundry with washer wall and bench, two small flats above.
Massive exposed-concrete library: tall reading hall of stacks, upper reading room + meeting room, deep concrete fins and slab crown.
Red/white striped 5-storey round tower with spiral stair, gallery deck, glazed lantern room with glowing lens; keeper's cottage.
Red-brick 3-storey Victorian terrace: bay window, black front door with fanlight, slate gable roof, chimney stacks.
Whitewashed 2-storey house with blue door and shutters, terracotta hip roof, balcony, bougainvillea boxes.
Stone-and-timber tavern: great hearth, bar, kitchen; half-timbered guest rooms upstairs; slate roof, hanging sign, ale barrels, well.
Low single-storey timber house with floor-to-ceiling glass, butterfly-flat shed roof with deep eaves, stone chimney, carport.
Ochre 2-storey riad: carved arch door, mashrabiya grilles, tiled lounge, guest rooms, roof terrace with lanterns.
Single-storey black-timber cabin with a steep slate gable, big picture window, fireplace, firewood stack.
Narrow 4-storey brownstone with raised stoop, double timber door, cornice, sash windows, flat roof with water tank.
12-sided white drum: visitor/lab floor, control room, telescope floor under a copper dome with an opening slit and a large telescope.

20x20 m, 10 floors: marble lobby + reception, 2 elevator shafts (car objects with level data) + fire stair, open-plan offices / meeting / pantry / server room, 5 vacant shell floors for custom fit-out, executive suite, roof with helipad and plant.
Cream stone 4-storey block: corner café with terrace, wrought-iron balconies, mansard slate roof with dormers, cornice.

Raised copper module house: pipe-frame base + deck, lower glazed kitchen/lab pod, interior stair to an upper sleeping module with wrap balcony, roof hatch, two large tilting solar panels, antenna mast, hydroponic planters.
Concrete 2-storey precinct: public lobby with front desk, squad office, holding/storage, upstairs open office, briefing room, server room.
Single-storey cream-brick post office: counter hall with rope queue, parcel storage, green post box, flag.
Steel-clad sawtooth hall full of treadmills and weight benches, glass front, neon sign.
3-storey brick school: classrooms with desks/whiteboards on every floor, library, front-yard basketball court, flagpole, clock.
Two-storey motel strip: office/lobby, rows of guest rooms each with its own balcony walkway, neon MOTEL sign, parking.
Vermilion shrine hall on a stone plinth with sliding paper doors and a curved slate gable; torii gate, stone lanterns, offering box, bell, sacred tree.

Corner shop with open frontage (raised roller shutters) on two streets: record & game corner, snack counter, shelves, arcade. Upper blue flat with wrap balcony and LED under-glow, rooftop garden with palms.
Long single-storey stucco ranch house with arched veranda, terracotta roof, living/dining/kitchen/bedrooms.

Four containers (blue 20ft bunks, yellow 40ft lab, grey 20ft mess, grey 40ft comms/lounge) on stilts around a glass stair tower; twin front stairs, upper balcony walkway + slanted canopy, antenna mast, dish, fuel drums.
3-storey copper-and-brick workshop: machine shop, drafting library, inventor's loft; giant brass gears, steam pipes, smokestacks, airship mooring mast.
Stone nave with tall lancet windows, rows of pews and altar, steep slate gable, square bell tower with brass bell and spire.
Large steel-clad supermarket: aisles of double shelves, wall of drink fridges, checkout counters, carts, front parking.
Stone base + log upper storey, wide low gable with deep eaves, wrap balcony with flower boxes, red shutters.

Stone podium with front stair, 3-storey timber pavilion (altar hall / scripture library / lookout) linked by interior stairs, verandas with red columns, triple curled hip roofs, neon-lit paifang gate and red lantern strings.

6x7 m five-storey neon tower: G/F DVD & gadget shop, 2F hacker den with servers, 3F capsule hostel, 4F neon bar, 5F loft, roof hut with antennas. Grimy steel cladding, fans, pipes, vertical neon signs.
Giant oak with a wrap deck at 4.5 m reached by a timber stair, a gabled cabin (bed, desk, lantern) and a rope ladder to a crow's-nest lookout.
Stone ground-floor pub with bar and booths, half-timbered upper floor of guest rooms, steep tile gable, lanterns, hanging sign.

Glass-walled concrete living pavilion (living/dining/kitchen island), floating stair, cantilevered upper volume with master suite + ensuite, 2nd bedroom, study, garage with car, roof terrace, infinity pool & deck.

Charcoal composite villa with cyan circuit-trace lighting: gated courtyard, glowing steps, G/F lounge + kitchen + game room, 2F suite with balcony, west wing with roof terrace reached by an outside stair.
Converted brick warehouse: G/F workshop and garage bay with roller door, two double-height studio lofts above, sawtooth glazed roof.
8-sided brick windmill: grain store, millstone floor with reefing gallery, miller's loft; timber cap with four lattice sails (rotate prop).
12-sided stone tower: library, alchemy lab, bedchamber and star-gazing study linked by a spiral stair; tall blue cone roof, glowing crystals.
Island terrain + streets + lamps + trees that hosts every TownKit building.
